description: This file contains tests for decoding health snapshot JSON data in the OpenClaw project, specifically testing the decoding logic against clean JSON, noisy input, and invalid JSON cases.

classes.name: HealthDecodeTests
classes.description: Provides unit tests for decoding health snapshot JSON data, including handling of clean JSON, noisy input, and invalid JSON.

methods.name: `decodes clean JSON`
methods.description: Tests decoding of a minimal but complete JSON payload representing health data.

methods.name: `decodes with leading noise`
methods.description: Tests decoding JSON data embedded within noisy log text to ensure robustness.

methods.name: `fails without braces`
methods.description: Tests decoding behavior when given invalid JSON data that does not contain valid JSON structures.
